integrity: The automorphism dimension is derived from Cox ring graded pieces and the maxima are proved symbolically; finite age and monomial enumeration is used only as a regression check.
scientific_limitations: Specialized to ordinary weighted projective spaces P(1^r,a,b) over C; the theorem is not a global maximization over all weighted projective spaces, and originality is based on documented searches rather than an exhaustive literature proof.
title: Sharp automorphism-dimension bounds in the two-heavy weighted-projective family
